test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Sitesh and Suresh are maternal cousins. The mother of Suresh, Gita has a daughter Samiksha. Anjali is Samiksha's paternal aunt. How is Anjali related to Gita?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

1) The mother of Suresh, Gita has a daughter Samiksha. 

2) Anjali is Samiksha's paternal aunt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f43ff6777b3f8d4d8480f56eec083e5174b5e7b1e40d650ff8f6251dea97f9f7.png] 

3) Sitesh and Suresh are maternal cousins. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f43ff6777b3f8d4d8480f56eec083e5174b5e7b1e40d650ff8f6251dea97f9f7.png] 

Thus, Anjali is Gita's sister-in-law of husband's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
